Descender offset tuner

Drag the slider to shift g, j, p, q, y down (positive) or up (negative) relative to the other letters, which stay fixed. All letters are currently bottom-aligned to their own bounding box, which is why the descender letters' bodies sit too high by default.

Negative = move up  ·  Positive = move down (further below the baseline)
Scales j up in place, and grows its side spacing by the same proportion so it doesn't crowd o/e next to it.
